name: pulse-music-app
description: Pulse Music - High-Fidelity Cross-Platform Music Streaming App by Pushkar Hiremath
author: Pushkar Hiremath

scripts.build:all: npm run build:icons && npm run build:certs && npm run build:packages
scripts.dist:mac-windows-host: npm run build && npx electron-packager . "Pulse Music" --platform=darwin --arch=universal --out=dist/mac-app --app-version=2.4.0 --overwrite
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npx electron-packager . "Pulse Music" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist/win-app --app-version=2.4.0 --overwrite --asar && node scripts/build_win_installer.js
scripts.dist:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
